No further approval between those checks and launch. Stop after the registered decision.
authority.approval_record: the user's message of 2026-09-27 (quoted in the assessment, section 10); no separate approval file

question: Does the separately logged exploration credit, added to an unchanged btt_reward_v2 during training only, let PPO discover a crossing (a native-verified clear, a replay-verified qualified crossing or a replay-verified left-target break) from normal tick-0 starts at the same budget, without displacing target collection?
only_difference: the [exploration] table of the experimental profiles (btt_explore_cells_v1, beta 0.05, cap 1.0, grid_divisor 24, harmonic decay), i.e. the learner reward during training; compatibility views differ only in the exploration keys

arms.exp: m7o_s{0,1,2}_x1: fresh models, empty tables, btt_policy_obs_v3_entities + btt_reward_v2 + btt_explore_cells_v1
arms.ctl: runs/m7n/campaign/m7n_s{0,1,2}_v3 (the M7n v3 runs), reused only while the R1 reproduction and the record verification pass

sequencing: strictly sequential, one run at a time, s0, s1, s2; the launch gate before each

reward.both_arms: btt_reward_v2 (frozen values); the experimental arm adds btt_explore_cells_v1 to the LEARNER reward during training only; rows keep the v2 return and log the credit separately

launch_gate.readings: a failed reading is re-measured after 60 s, at most 5 readings

registered_settings.monitor: m7d Monitor: hard alerts stop the run (a row violating its btt_reward_v2 closed form or its exploration record, more than 10 game processes or listeners in two samples, a changed user config, low disk)
stop_conditions: a failed control check or record verification
registered_settings.after_a_stop: the campaign stops and reports; a stopped run is moved to _partial and preserved; nothing is fixed or relaunched by this driver
registered_settings.evaluation: post hoc, frozen parameters, tick-0 starts only (the M7n protocol), btt_eval_metrics_v1, plain v2 workers (no exploration wrapper, no credit, no table access), clear verification, crossing verification (btt_qualified_crossing_v1), census; the training tables' sha256 must be identical before and after evaluation
registered_settings.training_inputs: tick-0 episodes of the run itself only; never fixtures, TAS, traces, recordings, pilot checkpoints or tables, other runs
registered_settings.initialisation: fresh models only: ckpt_000000000 must equal the fresh construction AND the M7n run's initial set of the seed; every slot's table must be empty at the first episode (table_episodes_before 0); nothing loaded from the pilots
registered_settings.never: native RNG state is never inspected, logged, validated, controlled, compared or hashed

status.required: a PASSED R1 record on code.control_check_sha256 and executable.sha256 AND a PASSED record verification on this rule; otherwise train is blocked; replacement controls are never trained by this driver

control.procedure: rl/m7o_control_check.py (R1: 3 x 102,400 fresh M7n-profile runs vs the M7n ckpt_000102400 digests and rows) + rl/m7o_control_verify.py (identity, evaluation verifiers, clear / crossing candidates, rule inputs vs the M7n analysis); rerun whenever the control-check fingerprint, the executable or the rule changes

pilot.never_reused: no campaign run loads a pilot checkpoint, optimizer state, table or statistics; every run starts from the fresh construction with empty tables

evaluation_protocol.crossing_verification: rl/m7n_crossing.verify_crossings_in (btt_qualified_crossing_v1) on the experimental finals; the control's M7n documents re-verified by crossing_inputs
evaluation_protocol.no_exploration_in_evaluation: evaluation workers carry no [exploration] table (plain btt_reward_v2); rows must carry no explore record; the training tables' sha256 must be identical before and after evaluation
evaluation_protocol.inputs: rl/m7l_analysis.label_inputs on both arms' finals and the experimental initials; rl/m7n_crossing.crossing_inputs

not_evidence_of_success: exploration credit accumulated, its decay, cells discovered or any training-time behaviour
the pilot's +0.30 mean-target difference over 60 episodes (a stop-only regression diagnostic inside its band)
target improvement without a discovery event (gate 4)
